fact: The IMA, under the PADA project, issued terms of reference (version 1.1, 15 May 2026) to procure an e-learning platform for the civil-service school ENAPP to carry the Programa de Competências Digitais for the public sector.

The PADA terms of reference say Subcomponent 2.3 supports designing, piloting and expanding hybrid digital-skills programmes and courses at ENAPP, the national school of public administration, with a methodology to assess digital skills in the public sector.
The article lists Despacho Presidencial n.º 324/26 among recent authorisations for training local agents in digital skills, reported 2026-09-08.

A presidential despacho signed by President João Lourenco in October 2026 orders public-tender contracting of training centres to raise digital skills of the working population, especially public servants, at basic, intermediate and advanced levels, with the head of the Instituto de Modernização Administrativa delegated to approve the procedure.

On 22 May 2024 Angola's Institute of Administrative Modernisation signed an MoU with the e-Governance Academy under which a Digital Governance Academy will be established to develop digital governance programmes for government employees.

A presidential despacho authorised USD 20m for a Digital Skills Training Programme under PADA that targets the working population, especially youth, and public service staff, with basic, intermediate and advanced training run with INEFOP, ENAPP and the Data Protection Agency, per Valor Económico.
